pages.text: Occultism offers two storage solutions: the first is based on satchels, portable inventories with different functions depending on the type.$(br) Some are already obtainable, while others will require evolve in the mod first.$(br)

The second option is to follow the entries below that show the rituals related to the Magic Storage system.$(br) For full step-by-step instructions on building the storage system, see the $(thing)Magic Storage$() category.$(br)
